firstPlayerRule: With Character cards, the player holding the lowest-numbered Character card starts. In the first game, when no Character cards are used, the player who most recently read a Sherlock Holmes story starts.

sources.title: Beyond Baker Street — Z-Man Games English rulebook

internalEvidence: Rendered page 5 of the Z-Man-hosted English rulebook states that the lowest-numbered Character card determines the start player, with the most recent Sherlock Holmes story reader starting the introductory game without Character cards. It also confirms clockwise play. Source SHA-256: e822773db902e4fcf17a12e89bcb44a88668abc4e7f6698b4708ece60ec67f96. The legacy image host's certificate is outside its validity period; the same URL is indexed as the publisher PDF. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: No tie-break is given for equally recent Sherlock Holmes reading; the Character cards are uniquely numbered.
